Value Creation as Our North Star We are driven by an unwavering commitment to creating value for all our stakeholders. By fostering a culture of teamwork, we unite our employees, customers, and partners to co-create solutions that deliver meaningful impact. Home » Careers Explore Our Open Positions Project Manager Remote United Kingdom About The Position Five Sigma is reinventing the way insurance claims are being handled. We are insurance and tech veterans who believe that efficiency is the name of the game. We build the most advanced data-oriented claims platform in the industry, allowing insurance companies to provide their customers the trust and experience they deserve SUMMARY We’re looking to hire a Project Manager to join our Project Management team, within our Professional Services group. In this role, you will be responsible for launching new customers on Five Sigma SaaS platform, as well as dealing with the onboarding of existing customers. To accomplish that, the Project Manager works with our customers to build out the initial application configuration and review the primary settings and functionality of Five Sigma’s platform and applications. The Five Sigma Project manager is responsible for the overall management of a project throughout its lifecycle ensuring our projects fall within the applicable scope, time, and budget, and occasionally assists during the pre-sale engagement. The Five Sigma Project manager can manage complex projects or smaller programs that require coordination of work between various parties like customer teams, Internal Five Sigma development and product teams, and other third parties that may be involved in a project. The day-to-day of this role includes hosting kick-off calls to coordinate, plan, and measure the implementation of new clients and ensuring the client is on track with their onboarding process. This includes traveling to meet clients, engaging with their external and internal teams, understanding & documenting their business and technical requirements, managing the implementation of the Five Sigma platform, and transitioning the client to the Customer Support & Success team. THE ROLE ● Conduct the project planning activities and manage the execution of large-scale, high-risk, or strategic projects from Initiating to successful go-live on time, scope and budget. ● Evaluate complex situations accurately and identify viable solutions that create successful outcomes for the customer. ● Manage relationships with project stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress and issues, in order to manage expectations on all project requirements and deliverables ● Ensure proper use of methodology, tools, and procedures ● Analyse risk, establish contingency plans and identify trigger events and responsibilities for initiating mitigating action ● Establish trust with clients by learning about their organization, processes, team member, and desired outcomes ● Work with a client’s internal and external teams to understand the operational and technical requirements of the project ● Ensure the timely and successful completion of projects, as well as the transition to the customer support & success team post-production ● Work with the customer to create end-user training and establish support channels for go-live and post-production support ● Plan and manage the project resource allocation with relevant departments within the organization ● Ability to manage multiple projects and clients at one time ● Provide technical, business consulting, and product expertise to customers enabling comprehensive implementations and solutions ● Enable and configure various product features that meet the customer's needs within contractual constraints or identify change requests when needed ● Identify use cases, roles, and other business requirements for each implementation Requirements ROLE REQUIREMENTS ● More than 5 years of project management experience in Insurtech large-scale strategic projects - Home » Careers Explore Our Open Positions Solution Architect Remote USA About The Position About Five Sigma Five Sigma is reinventing the way insurance claims are being handled. We are insurance and tech veterans who believe that efficiency is the name of the game. We build the most advanced data-oriented claims platform in the industry, allowing insurance companies to provide their customers the trust and experience they deserve About the role The Solution Architect owns that solution from definition through delivery. Working at the intersection of Sales, Product and Delivery, you will lead customer discovery, translate complex business and technical requirements into an implementation-ready solution design, and remain engaged throughout implementation to ensure the agreed architecture is carried through successfully. You will bring structure and clarity to complex enterprise engagements by defining the target solution, identifying risks and dependencies early, and aligning stakeholders before implementation begins. Your work will help customers make confident decisions while enabling Five Sigma to deliver consistently and at scale. Beyond individual customers, you will serve as a strategic feedback loop into Product. By identifying recurring gaps, integration patterns and emerging market needs across implementations, you will help turn customer insights into reusable capabilities and scalable product enhancements rather than one-off solutions. This is a high-impact role with the opportunity to shape how solution architecture operates at Five Sigma and to establish the standards, processes and practices that will support our continued enterprise growth. What you'll do Pre-Sales (support) · Partner with Sales to validate the solution approach before commercial commitment - including technical fit, implementation complexity, risks, assumptions and dependencies. · Bring business and technical depth to solution demos, and contribute to Statements of Work and implementation scoping. Discovery (you own this) · Lead discovery workshops with customer stakeholders; understand their business processes and operating model. · Map customer workflows to Five Sigma capabilities, and design the target solution architecture. · Draw clear lines between standard product, configuration, professional services, product enhancements and partner responsibilities. · Own the Solution Design Document - including business context and end-to-end solution flow, org/sub-org/line-of-business model, coverage and product taxonomy, integration architecture, non-functional requirements and roadmap alignment. · Own integration architecture decisions for each integrated system: synchronous vs. asynchronous, protocol (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, Kafka), file vs. live, push vs. pull, one-way vs. two-way, and authentication (OAuth 2.0, API key, bearer token, mTLS). · Define the non-functional posture: volume and throughput, SLA commitments, security and compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, DPA, data residency), feature-flag posture, availability and disaster recovery. · Align all stakeholders before implementation begins. Implementation (governance and continuity) · Clarify solution intent and resolve architectural questions as Delivery executes. · Review implementation against the agreed design; evaluate change requests and new requirements for alignment. · Capture implementation learnings and recurring customer requests, and feed them back into Product. Requirements What you'll bring Insurance domain · P&C claims lifecycle end to end : FNOL through settlement, including reserves, reinsurance, subrogation and salvage. · Policy structures: coverage, peril and incident distinctions; limits, deductibles, endorsements and bordereau reporting. · Regulatory context in at least one of our markets - FCA (UK), APRA (Australia), state DOI (US), GDPR/DPA. · Exposure to a range of customer archetypes: Lloyd's coverholders, MGAs, TPAs, direct insurers, InsurTechs and brokers. Technical · Integration architecture across REST, SOAP, webhooks, event streams and file-based patterns - with the ability to make synchronous/asynchronous, push/pull and protocol decisions independently. · API design fundamentals: OpenAPI/Swagger, authentication patterns, idempotency and error handling. · A configuration-first mindset - you know when to configure, when to request a product enhancement and when custom work is genuinely warranted. · Familiarity with modern SaaS architecture, including multi-tenancy, feature flags and role-based access control. Customer-facing · Workshop facilitation - you can run a two-hour discovery session with 5-15 mixed-role attendees and leave with actionable output. · Executive communication - you can present a solution design to C-level stakeholders and defend your architectural choices. · Strong written documentation discipline - the Solution Design Document is your primary artifact and must work for both engineering and business readers.
